requirements.requirement: node1 (the router for the private network) hands out DHCP addresses on the network shared by node2 and node3
requirements.summary: Executor discovered eth1 as the shared private segment on all three nodes, brought it up on node1, created UCI 'priv' interface (static 10.100.201.1/24 on eth1), added it to the firewall lan zone, and configured dhcp.priv as a dnsmasq DHCP server (pool 100-249, i.e. 10.100.201.100-249). node1's listening-socket snapshot after execution confirms dnsmasq bound to udp/67 and 10.100.201.1:53, and both node2 and node3 successfully obtained DHCP leases on that subnet from node1 (cmd-4147eb3643f24073, cmd-942753426bd54706), with node1's own dhcp.leases file recording both bindings (cmd-0f5cac8726a04d03, cmd-3d2796f124834e12) and node1 successfully pinging both addresses over eth1 (cmd-1821240c35644af3).

requirements.requirement: node2 always receives the same address across repeated DHCP leases
requirements.summary: A UCI dhcp host reservation mapping node2's eth1 MAC (02:80:cb:1f:a1:5e) to 10.100.201.50 was created (cmd-dea9fc74baca4d03). node2 obtained 10.100.201.50 on initial connect (cmd-4147eb3643f24073), again after a manual disconnect/reconnect (cmd-79d052bd404b45e7, confirmed in node1's lease file via cmd-0f5cac8726a04d03), again after node1's restart (cmd-3f89c35d55a14589, confirmed via node1's lease file cmd-3d2796f124834e12 and ping cmd-1821240c35644af3), and again after node2's own restart (cmd-f5da70eeadaf47ba). The address was consistent across all four observed renewal events.

requirements.requirement: node3 is addressed from the general DHCP pool (not a fixed reservation)
requirements.summary: No host reservation was created for node3's MAC (02:7a:2f:3f:c3:36); it drew from the dynamic pool defined by dhcp.priv (start=100, limit=150). It obtained 10.100.201.211 on initial connect (cmd-942753426bd54706), consistently on renewal (cmd-2349c168eda243d1), and again after both node1's and node3's own restarts (cmd-9b0c5aa3f422436c), confirmed via node1's lease file (cmd-0f5cac8726a04d03, cmd-3d2796f124834e12, cmd-1821240c35644af3) and by ping from node1.

requirements.requirement: node1 restart evidence protocol: pre-restart baseline, restart, differing boot identity, recovered service/config state
requirements.summary: Pre-restart boot_id 09e21629... and healthy dnsmasq/UCI state captured (cmd-b3bb4932de6b48db), reboot issued (cmd-803a6c5431944a42), transient SSH timeouts observed (cmd-38f8522a8b3c4d35), then a new boot_id a702449a... with 0-minute uptime (cmd-cd56cedee5674859), followed by confirmation that the UCI priv network/dhcp config, the static eth1 IP, and the dnsmasq service all persisted and resumed running (cmd-d243b97b8c0e44fb). This is corroborated by the fixed after_executor snapshot showing dnsmasq listening on the expected sockets post-restart.

requirements.requirement: node2 and node3 restart evidence protocol: pre-restart baseline, restart, differing boot identity, recovered network/lease state
requirements.summary: Both nodes had pre-restart boot_id captured (cmd-91bbfe68ede4451e, cmd-acb87febbc214460), reboots issued (cmd-7cac99bfd7374643, cmd-d013ffcfab964311), and new boot_ids confirmed with 0-minute uptime (cmd-525eb4ceacc1405a for node2, cmd-e250bbf4066446e3 for node3), matching the fixed after_executor snapshot boot-identity diffs. Post-restart, both nodes auto-reconnected eth1 via NetworkManager and re-acquired their correct addresses (node2: 10.100.201.50 in cmd-f5da70eeadaf47ba; node3: 10.100.201.211 in cmd-9b0c5aa3f422436c), further corroborated by node1's post-restart ping (cmd-1821240c35644af3).

overall_summary: All three material outcomes of the task — node1 acting as DHCP server on the shared private network, node2 receiving a fixed address across repeated leases, and node3 drawing from the general pool — are directly and repeatedly demonstrated, including consistency after each node's independent restart. The mandatory restart-evidence protocol was also completed cleanly for all three nodes with clear pre/post boot-identity changes and confirmed recovery of relevant service and networking state. No unnecessary or unrestored mutations were found in the command trace.
limitations: Since after_prepare is an alias of before_prepare (prepare disabled), the executor-caused-vs-preexisting distinction relies solely on the before_prepare vs after_executor diff, which is adequate here but leaves no independent preparer baseline.

node1's post-restart boot-identity observation in the fixed after_executor snapshot returned a connection error (return_code 255) rather than a captured value, so the automated cross-check for node1 relies on the executor's own timeline evidence (cmd-cd56cedee5674859) rather than the fixed snapshot.

Firewall rule effectiveness was inferred from UCI zone membership rather than an explicit packet-level test of DHCP/firewall traffic beyond the successful lease acquisitions and pings, though those successful leases and pings are themselves strong indirect confirmation.

operational_hygiene.summary: Reviewing the chronological command trace, every state-changing action ties directly to the task: bringing eth1 up (cmd-7a588164828d4c7d, cmd-cd65be3ef8e24c46, cmd-55fd24f6e6c445c4) was a necessary prerequisite for configuring/using the private network; the UCI network/firewall/dhcp changes on node1 (cmd-9065d43165d0477a, cmd-92e3be446a98420e, cmd-dea9fc74baca4d03) directly implement the required DHCP behavior; the nmcli disconnect/reconnect cycles on node2/node3 (cmd-79d052bd404b45e7, cmd-3f89c35d55a14589, cmd-2349c168eda243d1) were bounded, low-risk actions used to prove repeated-lease behavior and were self-restoring; and the three reboots (cmd-803a6c5431944a42, cmd-7cac99bfd7374643, cmd-d013ffcfab964311) fulfill the mandatory node-restart evidence protocol. No abandoned files, failed services, or unnecessary/unexplained mutations were observed; the after_executor temporary-files diff on node1 only shows expected runtime artifacts from the new dnsmasq/eth1 configuration (e.g. /tmp/run/dnsmasq.cfg01411c.eth1.dhcp), and node2/node3 diffs show only expected reboot-generated systemd-private directories, not residue from experimentation.
